points: Your site shows 118 reviews, but 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers get no proof at the click. Put 118 on the creative and open two of your next ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 3% off on ₹10,000 and above, yet only 1 of 24 ads mention percent off, so new buyers have no reason to act today. Put that 3% off in the first line of three new ads.

Your 24 copy ads open with 15 different stories, and the biggest opener leads 5 of them. Each new story starts from scratch, so none gets enough repeats. Pick the two most used openings and build the next batch from them.

19 ads have run 60+ days, and the oldest has been live since January 2026, so the message is holding up. Build three more variations of that ad with new opening lines, and keep the same product and return line.
